idea.title: Wayfinder Router: deterministic routing of queries between local and hosted LLM

plan.problem: Freelancers and small businesses struggle to manually chase unpaid invoices.
plan.solution: Tracks outstanding invoices, sends reminders, and generates reports.
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses worldwide who need to manage their finances efficiently.
plan.demo_script: Shows creating an invoice, listing all invoices, sending a reminder, generating a report, and setting an alert.
